title: Gridfinity cutout library item
description: One cutout library item exported from the bin designer: shapes saved apart from any bin, with their groups and meshes, to place in another bin. Each cutout has the same shape as in a bin design. Unknown properties are allowed so newer files still validate. See https://gridfinitylayouttool.com/schema

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema. Ignored by the importer; present only so editors offer completion.

type.description: Document discriminator. The importer rejects any other value.

name.description: Item name. An empty or missing name imports under a default one.

params.description: The saved shapes, as the matching part of a bin design's params. Coordinates are mm with the origin at the bottom-left of the item's box; placing the item moves it to the drop point.

cutouts.description: The saved shapes. Ids only need to be unique within the file; placing the item gives each shape, group and mesh a new id.

cutoutGroupNames.description: Display names for the groups the shapes form, keyed by group id.

meshAssets.description: Imported STL imprint meshes, written inline, keyed by the id that a shape 'mesh' cutout's meshId references.
